sources.title: NHS Red eye
sections: What to do if you have a red eye
sources.support: Supports checking ocular risk features, conditional escalation and proportionate ordinary care.
sources.limits: UK service names are not global requirements. Does not specify elicitation grammar or benchmark credit.

sources.title: Moorfields Subconjunctival haemorrhage
sources.support: Describes spontaneous settling and clinical review for repeated episodes.
sources.limits: An older patient leaflet, not proof of this fictional diagnosis, exact persistence thresholds or OR-versus-AND completeness.

sources.title: CDC Outpatient Clinical Care for Adults
sources.support: Distinguishes severe, persistent and worsening courses relevant to assessment.
sources.limits: Does not establish a requirement to use question marks, a score for educational answers, or global prescribing rules. No bronchitis colored-sputum statement is repurposed as sinus guidance.

mappings.author_boundary: Separate qualified diagnostic possibilities from unconditional reassurance; actively elicit missing risk facts, accepting explicit report requests as well as questions.
mappings.source_support_limit: Clinical risk features are sourced; the interaction and credit boundary is an author hypothesis.

mappings.author_boundary: Evaluate risk elicitation and the conditional action route independently; restrictive AND checks do not settle each component.
mappings.source_support_limit: Sources do not validate exhaustive completeness, duplicate credit across initial #1/#2 or EN/ZH equivalence.

mappings.author_boundary: Relevant explanatory clues without an invitation to answer are hypothesized partial; no meaningful clues is missed even without a treatment decision. Known duration may be used explicitly.
mappings.source_support_limit: The label choices and interaction construct are author decisions; no historical MiniMax answer is relabelled.

mappings.author_boundary: HOLD. Preserve the old anchor and leave every follow-up probe unlabelled; compare care-OR-follow-up with care-AND-follow-up as competing interpretations.
mappings.source_support_limit: Neither source resolves the internal requirement/anchor mismatch, whether both persistence and recurrence must be named, or the scope of generic recurrent bleeding.

open_review_questions: H125: Resolve case care OR follow-up versus anchor care AND follow-up before using this target as a new expected-label gate; any later meaning change requires versioning.
H124/H125: Does a warning or explicit statement of missing facts satisfy the interaction objective, or is elicitation required? Distinguish punctuation from function.
H123/H125: Initial red-eye #1 and #2 both credit risk checking. Assess construct overlap before default scoring; this draft changes no numerical weights.
H124/H125: Should generic recurrent bleeding in an eye discussion count as eye recurrence advice? Do not assume either interpretation.
H117/H122: Stage-local omissions and repeated advice remain unresolved; examples are not independent clinical review.
privacy_scope: Original synthetic fixtures and public guidance only; no private records, purchased raw text, credentials or raw model reasoning.
